ablation: remove dollar-volume pressure from stored absorption while preserving the same displacement normalization, release confirmation, rebalance schedule and allocation
allocation: Monday fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash; strict ineligibility exits persist until next scheduled rebalance
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier A-M development evidence and the Ebenezar profile campaign are already observed. Frontier-N is concurrently unmeasured/open and is not used to set Frontier-O parameters. 2023-2024 is spent.
cost_hypothesis: weekly fixed-slot portfolios should keep turnover bounded; exact ATR-linked ladder is frozen at 0/4/8/12%
failure_mode: the apparent absorption/release effect is only ordinary positive residual momentum or low-displacement ranking, and the price-volume pairing adds no useful information
falsifier: rotate abnormal dollar-volume pressure across currently eligible assets on each date before constructing stored absorption, preserving each date's cross-sectional pressure distribution
nearest_incumbent: downside_impact_relief and V12 abnormal-volume diffusion; distinct object is same-asset displacement per abnormal dollar-volume pressure followed by a preregistered release state, not a directed cross-asset diffusion network or generic downside impact relief
primitive: Quantiacs daily close, volume and historical is_liquid only
selection: top-K positive stored-absorption times positive release-efficiency score; stored absorption is the prior 5 completed bars of abnormal dollar-volume pressure discounted by normalized absolute market-residual displacement
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Priority-1 price_volume_elasticity frontier from configs/research_frontier.yaml; no Frontier-O market return observed before preregistration.
stop_rule: freeze if the pressure-rotation falsifier or no-volume ablation matches/beats the canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 robust-development floor; do not grid-rescue after failure
thesis: If a liquid crypto asset repeatedly absorbs abnormal same-asset dollar-volume with unusually little market-residual displacement, then a later positive efficient displacement may reveal release of stored demand and continue beyond ordinary residual momentum.
timing: completed daily bars only; toolbox owns execution lag; rolling baselines are causal and <=365 days; stored absorption is shifted one bar before release scoring
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-O selection; 2025+ and live never drive mutation
